nodes.label: Multi-Agent Design Pattern (in-process async)

nodes.rationale: client_max_body_size must be raised (100M) or multi-image vision batches get 413.

nodes.label: Deployment & Update Workflow
nodes.rationale: Restart only while idle since restart cuts replies and interrupts studio jobs.

nodes.label: Fail-Fast Error Policy
nodes.rationale: Deterministic client errors (400/401/403/404/413/422) fail fast; only network timeouts retry.
